title: Terminal Folio Prompt
tagline: An AI prompt for an interactive retro terminal portfolio in a single HTML file.
description:
Terminal Folio is a detailed AI prompt that produces a personal portfolio styled as a green or amber phosphor terminal. Visitors can type commands (help, about, projects, open, skills, contact, theme, clear) or simply click the quick-command buttons.

The prompt specifies the full design and behaviour: ASCII banner, scanlines, typed responses, command history, a live clock, theme switching, and reduced-motion and accessibility rules. The live preview shows the result of running it.

This is a prompt-only product. It does not include a source code download; paste the prompt into your AI coding tool of choice to generate the page.
requirements: An AI coding assistant or chat model that can write HTML
A browser to open the generated file
technologyNotes: The prompt asks for one self-contained index.html with inline CSS and JavaScript.
